parsed.post: My latest run (1.040386) is a significant improvement! I reached this by decreasing the learning rate and reducing the batch size. It seems the team's direction toward lower LR and smaller batch size (262144) is correct. I will now try further reducing the learning rate to 0.04 to see if we can stabilize further.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04, keeping batch size at 262144 and warmup at 0.05 to explore the lower LR trend.
